repairPrompt: Repair this JavaScript function. Return JSON {"code":"function applyEvents(initial, events) { ... }"}. Pure function only; no imports, I/O, dynamic code or external libraries. Keep API. initial is an integer balance in kobo; events have id:string, amountMinor:integer, synced:boolean. Apply each synced event exactly once by id, keep unsynced IDs in queued in first-seen order without duplicates, let a later synced occurrence supersede its queued copy. Negative integer amounts valid. Reject fractional/nonfinite amounts via throwing Error, including unsynced events. Do not mutate inputs. Return {balanceMinor, applied, queued} with ID arrays in first applied / first remaining queued order. Reject invalid initial integer. Current buggy function: function applyEvents(initial, events) { let balance=initial; for (const e of events) balance += e.amountMinor/100; return {balanceMinor:balance, applied:events.map(e=>e.id),queued:[]}; }
